dict.string: Capturing a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file asks your browser for the document's address and content.
When you capture a Google Doc with fn+W or fn+T, your browser saves the document to Downloads; Mercurius reads that one file and deletes it.
Mercurius records only after you start dictation. On-device speech keeps audio on this Mac. Cloud speech sends audio to OpenRouter, or directly to ElevenLabs when you choose Scribe.
Mercurius uses Apple speech on this Mac for local dictation after you start recording. It downloads only the languages you choose and never switches to cloud speech on its own.
